title: SAM.gov Opportunities → Markdown input
description: Search U.S. federal contract opportunities via the official SAM.gov Opportunities API v2 (https://api.sam.gov/opportunities/v2/search). Bring your own free public API key — without one the API returns HTTP 404 and those rows are free. No HTML scrape. POC emails/phones are never exported.

samApiKey.title: SAM.gov public API key (required for live data)
samApiKey.description: Your free SAM.gov Public API Key. Get it: sign in at https://sam.gov/ → Account Details → Public API Key (or see https://open.gsa.gov/api/get-opportunities-public-api/). Passed as the api_key query parameter. WITHOUT a key the API returns HTTP 404 — those rows are marked failed and NOT charged. Stored encrypted; never logged. The publisher does not buy or host a SAM key.

keywords.title: Keywords (title filter)
keywords.description: Passed to the official title query parameter (substring match on opportunity title).

postedFrom.title: Posted from (MM/dd/yyyy)
postedFrom.description: Start of posted-date window. Format MM/dd/yyyy (SAM requirement). Max span with postedTo is 1 year. If omitted, computed from daysBack.

postedTo.title: Posted to (MM/dd/yyyy)
postedTo.description: End of posted-date window. Format MM/dd/yyyy. Defaults to today (UTC).

daysBack.title: Days back (if postedFrom omitted)
daysBack.description: When postedFrom is empty, search the last N days ending at postedTo/today. Max 365.

ncode.title: NAICS code (ncode)
ncode.description: Official ncode filter — up to 6 digits (e.g. 541512).

ptype.title: Procurement type (ptype)
ptype.description: Official ptype code(s), comma-separated. o=Solicitation, p=Presolicitation, k=Combined synopsis/solicitation, r=Sources sought, s=Special notice, a=Award notice, u=Justification (J&A), g=Sale of surplus, i=Intent to bundle.

organizationName.title: Organization / agency name
organizationName.description: Official organizationName filter (department or sub-tier keyword).

noticeIds.title: Notice ID list (optional direct lookup)
noticeIds.description: Optional. When set, each noticeId is fetched via the official noticeid parameter (still requires postedFrom/postedTo window). Overrides keyword search.

state.title: Place of performance state
state.description: Two-letter US state code (official state filter), e.g. VA.

typeOfSetAside.title: Set-aside code
typeOfSetAside.description: Official typeOfSetAside (e.g. SBA, 8A, HZC, SDVOSBC, WOSB). See open.gsa.gov docs.

status.title: Opportunity status
status.description: active | inactive | archived | cancelled | deleted (when supported by SAM).

maxNotices.title: Max notices
maxNotices.description: Stop after this many successful notice cards.

pageSize.title: Page size (limit per API call)
pageSize.description: Official limit per page (max 1000). Pagination uses offset+=page.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel description fetches / noticeId lookups. SAM rate-limits; 2 is usually safe.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retries for HTTP 429 (honours Retry-After), 5xx and timeouts. 400/401/403/404 (incl. missing key) are not retried.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for each SAM.gov API call.

fetchDescriptions.title: Fetch description text
fetchDescriptions.description: When true, follow the official noticedesc URL for a short description excerpt (emails/phones scrubbed). Extra API calls count against your SAM daily quota.

descriptionMaxChars.title: Description excerpt max chars
descriptionMaxChars.description: Truncate description excerpt. 0 skips description body even if fetchDescriptions is true.
